īti: [(1)i+ti] (thī) CL=8 I gamane,ti,dīghādi. Dhāna,ṭī.401. Anatthāya eti āgacchatīti īti, upaddavo. Nīti,dhā,4.(2)ī+ti,vi,pi,dhāna]. (1) harm, danger, the destructive dahmma. (B) danger that is lust, body/form, Abhisaṅkhāra etc., (C) danger that is calamity. Anītika-(D)-see. (D) suffering. Anītika-(E)-see. (C) destruction, without effect. Anītika-(F)- see.
ītiha: [Īti+hana+kvi] (ti) CL=8 (1) It removes all dangers (Brahmacariya). (2) Evil effects, which occur together. Anītiha- See also.
ītipaṭinissagga: [Īti+paṭinissagga] (pu) CL=8 dhamma which is cause the renunciation of danger (such as lust, body, Abhisaṅkhāra) that is Nirvana.
ītipaṭippassaddhi: [Īti+paṭippassaddhi] (thī) CL=8  the dhamma which the cessation of dangers, that is Nirvana. Ītipaṭinissagga-see.
ītippahāna: [Īti+pahāna] (na) CL=8 dhamma which removes dangers that is Nibbāna.Ītipaṭinissagga- see.
ītivūpasama: [Īti+vūpassama] (pu) CL=8  the dhamma which is  the peaceful source of danger that is Nirvana. Itipaṭinissagga - Look.
